car.name: Gromwell 1985
car.description: Henri Toivonen / Neil Wilson, 1985 RAC Rally-winning Delta S4 Group B inspiration. Mid-engine twincharged 1759cc inline-four and permanent AWD. Original logo-free interpretation; simulation setup is not claimed as exact RAC equipment.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: 1985 Lancia Delta S4 Group B, Henri Toivonen / Neil Wilson, RAC Rally winner. Not Delta HF Integrale or S4 Stradale.

sources.access: Manufacturer retrospective identifies exact winning crew/event, Group B, 1759cc mid-mounted four-cylinder, turbocharger plus supercharger, permanent AWD and composite tubular-frame construction. Performance numbers are retrospective context, not event setup.

estimates: 493bhp (approximately 500 CV),966kg and155mph (approximately250km/h) are selected from manufacturer retrospective context,not measured1985RAC figures.360lbft,3.5s0-60,8000redline and entire torque curve are simulation estimates. Source torque typo deliberately not used.

Five-speed manual,all ratios/final drive,shift and launch behavior,front/rear torque split,differentials,dimensions/tracks/CG,colliders,suspension,alignment,brakes,aerodynamics,tank90L and equal205/65R15 rally tires are game setup estimates,not verified RAC equipment.
Twincharging is recorded as engine identity but shared simulation uses the authored torque curve,not a bespoke compound-boost model. Auto Assist is accessibility behavior,not a factory automatic.

Original offwhite/teal/orange eight-view body,white wheels and squared rollcage cockpit are artistic interpretations,not sponsor-livery or exact cockpit replicas. Live digital gauges,shared steeringwheel and sound are gameplay conventions. Original PNG alpha retained; native wheel normalization applies only to decoded copy.
